ticketTitle: Fix: Cashier product picker search does nothing (stub function)
ticketDescription:
## Source

Discovery `search-cashier-transactions-shift-stock`, file: `.caf/discovery/search-cashier-transactions-shift-stock/prd.md` + `flow.md`

## Problem

In the cashier product picker (`apps/web/src/modules/transaction/components/Product.vue:190`), `UiSearch` is wired to a `search()` function, but that function only does `console.log(form.value)` — it never calls `fetchProduct()`. Typing in the search box does nothing during checkout. The backend (`GET /api/v1/products`, `ProductsQueryDto` in `apps/api/src/products/products.service.ts:34-41`) already supports `search` correctly (`name: { contains: search }`) — this is a frontend-only gap.

## Target User

Cashiers using the POS screen (`/cashier`) who need to find a product quickly while a customer is waiting.

## Scope of This Ticket

* `Product.vue`: replace the `search()` stub with a real call to `fetchProduct()` passing `form.value.search` as the `search` param, following the working pattern already used in `apps/web/src/modules/product-lists/pages/index.vue:212-223`.
* Reset `pagination.page` to 1 when the search keyword changes.
* Check whether `UiSearch` already has built-in debounce before adding a separate debounce in this component (avoid double-debounce/request storm).
* No backend changes needed.

## Out-of-Scope

* Product list page (already correct, not touched).
* Full-text/fuzzy search.
* Adding automated test coverage (flagged as pre-existing gap, not fixed here).

## Flow

Cashier types in `UiSearch` in the product picker panel → `search()` now sends `search` param to `fetchProduct()` → grid updates with matching products, pagination resets to page 1.

## Success Metric

Typing a product name in the cashier search box filters the product grid to matching results.

## Dependency

* Pattern reference: `apps/web/src/modules/product-lists/pages/index.vue` (already correct).
* `Product.vue` has no detected automated test coverage — verify manually before merge.
